# Excelsior LLC

> John Vajda is a Pain Reprocessing Therapy Coach at Excelsior LLC. Based in Boulder, Colorado. Coaching by video anywhere. Coaching is not medical care. 66% of people were pain-free or nearly pain-free after trying PRT. See the Data: https://excelsior-prt.com/#data. Book a free 30 minute discovery call to see if it is a good fit. Questions: email hello@excelsior-prt.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://excelsior-prt.com/): Pain Reprocessing Therapy & Somatic Coaching, the process, who it is for, and common questions.
- [My Story](https://excelsior-prt.com/pages/my-story/): John Vajda on living with chronic pain and why he coaches.
- [Workshops](https://excelsior-prt.com/pages/workshops/): Free live workshops on Pain Reprocessing Therapy (PRT) and Somatic Therapy to introduce you to the basics of the practice and to provide a community for connection and healing. The first is 60 minutes on Zoom. Date TBD. Get on the list: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfVeUX0v6dp-Gq9xOvARHVypW99JEgCyEF5PvtAiMafOe6B4w/viewform. Additional workshops will be made available soon!
- [Payment received](https://excelsior-prt.com/pages/paid/): Where a buyer lands after paying for a session pack, with the link to book a discovery call.
- [Full text](https://excelsior-prt.com/llms-full.txt): The offer, process, questions, and bio in one file.
